svg.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Liberation Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.aria-label: figbank's own tracked files, as a tree: the bank visualizing its own toolkit, laid out by treelayout.js from nothing but each file's directory.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Liberation Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: figbank/, as a tree — every tracked file, laid out from its own path.
